title: Untested reachable surfaces from LCLI-467, and the config-dependent-git-query shape they share
description:
Found by an adversarial reviewer during PR #140 (LCLI-467). No behaviour is wrong; these are reachable surfaces with no test, recorded so the gap is deliberate rather than discovered later.

1. renderPlain's "backlog-removal deleted files=... archive=..." / "backlog-removal kept" lines (src/commands/init.ts) and the renderPretty equivalents have NO test. --plain is a diff-stable contract surface per cli-contract section 7.2; these lines are additive so nothing breaks today, but their bytes are now part of the contract and untested.

2. The test.each flag-pairing table covers `--remove-backlog --adopt-manifest` but not `--no-remove-backlog --adopt-manifest`, even though the assertion's message branches on which spelling was passed.

3. No test for the two follow-up defects filed alongside this one (the gitignored-files gap, and the readiness/snapshot divergence).

WORTH CARRYING, because it is the generalisable part: the suite proves the readiness gate reads the DEFAULT-CONFIG answer, not that it DEMANDS the answer it needs. PR #140 landed a fix for one instance of that shape (status.showUntrackedFiles=no) with a test that mutation-checks correctly. Look for other places where a git query's result depends on repository or user config that a test fixture never sets.
